ds.description: Dataset which this Data belongs to

id.description: Id used to reference this Data within the Dataset to which it belongs

ref.description:
Pointer to the underlying {@link DataImpl} that this DataImpl.Ref represents. Either an instance of {@link DataImpl.Lazy} or a
reference to a {@link Data.Stateful} by {@link Data.Stateful#id}. There is never a need for any client or
downstream platform code to ever directly use this field. Use {@DataImpl#dereference} to follow the pointer if
required.

title:
Abstract parent type that acts as a layer of indirection between a actual instance of DataImpl in the Dataset. DataImpl.Ref
allows us to simulate mutability for DataImpl while ensuring that operations stay lazy. When we execute an operator which
is expected to mutate the underlying DataImpl, we create a new DataImpl.Lazy, then update the DataImpl.Ref's reference to point to
the newly created DataImpl. Thus, it appears that the DataImpl has mutated, yet we preserve metadata tracking and laziness.
{@link Mutable} mixin allows us to modify the {@link DataImpl.Ref} field in-place when a mutable operator is used.
name: DataImpl.Ref
